caption: The drawing depicts a single ankle-high shoe rendered in shades of reddish-brown with fine horizontal lines indicating texture. The shoe features a closed front, with a series of seven pairs of eyelets through which a lace, also colored in reddish-brown, is threaded diagonally. The upper edge of the shoe is outlined, and a padded inner lining in light gray is visible at the opening. The heel area of the shoe is accentuated with a black patch, providing contrast to the overall reddish-brown coloring. To the left of the shoe, there are two simple outline sketches in pencil showing the shoe's sole from a top-down view, one of which includes the outline of the lacing. The background is plain light beige, and the drawing is on slightly textured paper. The artist’s name, "META HOFFMAN," is inscribed in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Woman's Shoe
